rules.title: Application screening fee cap, conditions, receipts and refunds
rules.requirement: Landlords may charge an application screening fee only up to actual out-of-pocket screening costs and never more than $30 per applicant (CPI-adjustable annually from January 1, 1998). They must not charge a fee when no unit is or will soon be available, and may charge only if they use a first-come qualified-applicant process or refund the full fee to unselected applicants. They must also give an itemized receipt, return unused amounts, and provide a copy of the credit report within seven days.
rules.key_value: $30 per applicant (CPI-adjusted annually since 1998-01-01); refund within 7 days of selection or 30 days of submission under option (B)
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6 (as amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 67, Sec. 29 (AB 1170))
rules.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant.
rules.coverage_text: Applies when a landlord (an owner of residential rental property) or their agent receives a request to rent a residential property from an applicant, including guarantors and cosignors.
rules.exemptions: No refund is required for an applicant denied after consideration for not meeting the established screening criteria. An inadvertent fee from concurrent submissions is not a violation if refunded within seven days or applied to another unit at the applicant's option. Landlords may accept reusable screening reports under Section 1950.1. The section does not preempt federal or state housing assistance program rules on deposits and fees.
rules.interaction: Applies notwithstanding Section 1950.5. The screening fee is not 'security' under Section 1950.5 and is not an 'advance fee' under Bus. & Prof. Code § 10026.
rules.extraction_note: The effective date of January 1, 2026 is that of the AB 1170 amendment shown in the history note. The signing date is not stated. The CPI-adjusted current cap amount is not given. No penalty is stated in this section.
